import os import sqlite3 from datetime import datetime, timezone from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template_string, redirect, url_for app = Flask(__name__) app.secret_key = os.environ.get('APP_SECRET', 'wiki-secret') DB_PATH = 'db.sqlite3' # HTML templates ENTRY_LIST_TEMPLATE = ''' Wiki Entries

Wiki Entries

    {% for entry in entries %}
  • {{ entry.title }}
    • {% endfor %}

Create new entry

''' ENTRY_VIEW_TEMPLATE = ''' {{ entry.title }}

{{ entry.title }}

Last modified: {{ entry.lastModifiedAt }} by {{ entry.lastModifiedBy or 'Anonymous' }}
{{ entry.content | e }}

Back to entries list

''' EDIT_HISTORY_TEMPLATE = ''' Edit History - {{ entry.title }}

Edit History - {{ entry.title }}

Back to entries list

{% for edit in edits %}
{{ edit.timestamp }} by {{ edit.contributor or 'Anonymous' }} - Summary: {{ edit.summary or 'No summary' }}
{{ edit.diff | e }}
{% endfor %} ''' NEW_ENTRY_FORM = ''' Create New Entry

Create New Entry

Back to entries list

''' EDIT_FORM = ''' Edit Entry

Edit Entry: {{ entry.title }}

Back to entries list

''' def init_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, lastModifiedBy TEXT, lastModifiedAt TEXT NOT NULL )''') c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS edits ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, entry_id TEXT NOT NULL, contributor TEXT, summary TEXT, timestamp TEXT NOT NULL, old_content TEXT, new_content TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (entry_id) REFERENCES entries(id) )''') conn.commit() conn.close() init_db() def get_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return conn @app.route('/') def index(): conn = get_db() c = conn.cursor() c.execute('SELECT id, title, lastModifiedAt FROM entries ORDER BY lastModifiedAt DESC') entries = c.fetchall() conn.close() return render_template_string(ENTRY_LIST_TEMPLATE, entries=entries) @app.route('/entries/new', methods=['GET', 'POST']) def new_entry(): if request.method == 'POST': title = request.form.get('title', '').strip() content = request.form.get('content', '').strip() created_by = request.form.get('createdBy', 'Anonymous').strip() if not title or not content: return "Title and content are required", 400 entry_id = str(uuid4()) if False else str(uuid.uuid4()) timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() conn = get_db() try: c = conn.cursor() c.execute('INSERT INTO entries (id, title, content, lastModifiedBy, lastModifiedAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', (entry_id, title, content, created_by, timestamp)) # Record the initial edit c.execute('INSERT INTO edits (entry_id, contributor, summary, timestamp, old_content, new_content) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', (entry_id, created_by, 'Created', timestamp, '', content)) conn.commit() finally: conn.close() return redirect(url_for('index'), code=303) return render_template_string(NEW_ENTRY_FORM) @app.route('/entries/') def get_entry(entry_id): conn = get_db() c = conn.cursor() c.execute('SELECT id, title, content, lastModifiedBy, lastModifiedAt FROM entries WHERE id = ?', (entry_id,)) entry = c.fetchone() if entry is None: conn.close() return "Entry not found", 404 # Fetch edit history c.execute('SELECT contributor, summary, timestamp, old_content, new_content FROM edits WHERE entry_id = ? ORDER BY id', (entry_id,)) edits = c.fetchall() conn.close() # Render history diffs history_entries = [] for edit in edits: contrib = edit['contributor'] or 'Anonymous' summary = edit['summary'] or 'No summary' timestamp = edit['timestamp'] old_c = edit['old_content'] or '' new_c = edit['new_content'] or '' # Simple diff: show old vs new diff_lines = [] if old_c == new_c: diff_lines.append(f"No changes{summary or ''}") else: diff_lines.append(f"Old:") diff_lines.append(old_c) diff_lines.append(f"New:") diff_lines.append(new_c) history_entries.append({ 'contributor': contrib, 'summary': summary, 'timestamp': timestamp, 'diff': '\n'.join(diff_lines) }) return render_template_string(ENTRY_VIEW_TEMPLATE, entry=entry, history_entries=history_entries) @app.route('/entries//edits') def edit_history(entry_id): conn = get_db() c = conn.cursor() # Check entry exists c.execute('SELECT id FROM entries WHERE id = ?', (entry_id,)) if c.fetchone() is None: conn.close() return "Entry not found", 404 c.execute('SELECT contributor, summary, timestamp, old_content, new_content FROM edits WHERE entry_id = ? ORDER BY id', (entry_id,)) edits = c.fetchall() conn.close() history_entries = [] for edit in edits: contrib = edit['contributor'] or 'Anonymous' summary = edit['summary'] or 'No summary' timestamp = edit['timestamp'] old_c = edit['old_content'] or '' new_c = edit['new_content'] or '' diff_lines = [] if old_c == new_c: diff_lines.append(f"No changes{summary or ''}") else: diff_lines.append(f"Old:") diff_lines.append(old_c) diff_lines.append(f"New:") diff_lines.append(new_c) history_entries.append({ 'contributor': contrib, 'summary': summary, 'timestamp': timestamp, 'diff': '\n'.join(diff_lines) }) return render_template_string(EDIT_HISTORY_TEMPLATE, entry_id=entry_id, edits=history_entries) @app.route('/entries/', methods=['PUT']) def update_entry(entry_id): data = request.get_json(silent=True) if not data: return "Invalid request", 400 content = data.get('content', '').strip() modified_by = data.get('modifiedBy', 'Anonymous').strip() summary = data.get('summary', 'Edit').strip() if not content: return "Content is required", 400 conn = get_db() c = conn.cursor() # Get current entry c.execute('SELECT content, lastModifiedBy, lastModifiedAt FROM entries WHERE id = ?', (entry_id,)) current = c.fetchone() if current is None: conn.close() return "Entry not found", 404 old_content = current['content'] timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() # Update entry c.execute('UPDATE entries SET content = ?, lastModifiedBy = ?, lastModifiedAt = ? WHERE id = ?', (content, modified_by, timestamp, entry_id)) # Record edit c.execute('INSERT INTO edits (entry_id, contributor, summary, timestamp, old_content, new_content) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', (entry_id, modified_by, summary, timestamp, old_content, content)) conn.commit() conn.close() # Return updated entry info return jsonify({ 'id': entry_id, 'title': current['title'], 'content': content, 'lastModifiedBy': modified_by, 'lastModifiedAt': timestamp }) @app.route('/entries/', methods=['DELETE']) def delete_entry(entry_id): conn = get_db() c = conn.cursor() c.execute('DELETE FROM entries WHERE id = ?', (entry_id,)) c.execute('DELETE FROM edits WHERE entry_id = ?', (entry_id,)) conn.commit() conn.close() return '', 204 if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)
